lesson: A static HTML form cannot dynamically transfer user-selected booking values to an external WhatsApp URL without an appropriate mechanism. It breaks UX by losing data.

reusable_pattern.name: External CTA Data Integrity Pattern
reusable_pattern.resolution: Trade-off the Zero-JS invariant for a minimal, dependency-free Vanilla JS script that intercepts the form submission, reads inputs, encodes them into the external URL, and redirects. This preserves high-quality UX.
